name: Starlink Group 15-25
slot_a_text: B1088 is out on its 20th flight. It is aiming for the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You, 574 km downrange. It last flew Starlink Group 15-24 36 days ago.
slot_b_text: B1088 has flown 19 times in 22 months. The mix: fourteen Starlink, two NROL, one Transporter, and two others. At its fastest it was back on the pad in 9 days.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: Pogo oscillation is a coupled vibration between a rocket's propulsion system and its structure that can become dangerously unstable.
